findings.detail: The fund-level identity combines incompatible class or scale fields; the source class rows and consolidated total reconcile within NAV rounding.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation decides the flag. The filing reports total net assets of $12,434,974 thousand. Its four class share counts total 501,538,142 and every class reports NAV per share of $24.79, implying $12,433,130,540, only about 0.015% below filed net assets because NAV per share is rounded. The flagged residual of $489,103,168,000 is therefore impossible under the raw schedule and shows the extracted identity used incompatible class and/or scale values. This is a grounded extraction defect, not a filing-level identity failure.
